notes.title: Heartbeats Official Release!
notes.content:
You can now face your [i]Heart[/i] in the [b]full experience[/b]! After the latest adjustments, we can finally say that the [b]development is complete[/b]! All that's left now is to [b]play[/b]! 

Enjoy:  
[list]
[*] [b]5 unique characters[/b], each with their own goals and skins
[*] [b]Every run is different[/b] from the last, for a varied experience
[*] A constant challenge to stay on top of the [b]global leaderboards[/b]
[*] [b]Dynamic music and sound[/b] that adapt to the flow of the game
[/list]

We’re truly excited to share this news and to bring you the game in its [b]final form[/b]! A huge thank you to everyone who supported us and believed in us, giving us the push to reach this point. 
[b]Thank you so much!![/b]
Now...

it's time to [b]overcome the anxiety[/b]!

notes.title: Heartbeats: Build your Ego!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, how’s it going? The year has just begun, and we’re thrilled to share a brand-new early access update with you!

We’ve taken our time with this release, but here we are. We’re officially introducing a new character: Ego.

Ego’s concept revolves around power and cycles. While shooting, Ego becomes slower but gains power. Use their ability to release the power you’ve gathered for devastating effects. Sounds exciting, right? Don’t wait, try Ego now!

[h2]Gameplay and Features Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Character: Ego!
[*] Unlocking Valor and Kai is now easier.
[*] Added new spawn symbols for better clarity.
[*] Enjoy an alternative soundtrack during key moments in the game.
[/list]

It’s been an incredible three months of updates! Your feedback means a lot to us, don’t hesitate to reach out with your thoughts or questions.

Thank you for being part of this journey! 🎮

Unlocking Valor and Kai is now easier.
Added new spawn symbols for better clarity.
Enjoy an alternative soundtrack during key moments in the game.

notes.title: Heartbeats: You're looking good!
notes.content:
Thanks for your patience, here's the new early access update for Heartbeats! In this one, we've introduces tons of feedbacks, graphics updates and inner weapon balancing.

It's big, so let's dive in!

[h2]Gameplay and Features Updates![/h2]

[h3]Effects[/h3]
[list]
[*] The on-screen multiplier now bounces to the beat and changes color based on the BPM threshold.
[*] Scores displayed on screen now grow in size proportionally to the score earned.
[*] Spawns now fill radially from the center of the screen instead of bottom-up.
[*] A new mechanic introduced in the last update allows you to earn an extra life or score at the end of Nightmare mode. This now includes clear on-screen feedback when it happens.
[/list]

[h3]Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Harmony ability is now more precise and reliable. The spread between the bullets is much less random.
[*] Kai can now shoot up to four bullets, with an increased shooting rate and extended range.
[*] The Valor ability has been significantly enhanced—it's now much larger, and the sword’s damage has been increased.
[*] The third and fourth character skins now have animated effects, just like the second skin.
[*] The aim helper (the line on the screen) is now always active and cannot be deactivated.
[/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some enemies now include an attack prediction mechanic, providing universal feedback to make patterns clearer and more readable.
[*] All enemies now bounce in sync with the beat, enhancing the rhythmic gameplay experience.
[*] The Triple Laser enemy now has a wider angle between lasers, creating a larger zone to move.
[*] Enemy death effects and sound effects (SFX) have been improved based on the enemy’s importance and the current multiplier.
[*] The visibility and predictability of the tooth bullets fired by the Smile enemy have been improved.
[*] Movement patterns for the Star Finger enemy along the border are now slower.
[/list]

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
[*] You now have more time to adjust sensitivity settings during the tutorial.
[/list]

[h2]Coming Next![/h2]
[list]
[*] Fifth character on the road! 
[*] New gameplay variants to keep the challenge up!
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update! Thank you for your feedback and support in helping us enhance the gameplay experience!

notes.title: Heartbeats: Keep Breathing!
notes.content:
Hello! Finally here’s the first early access update for Heartbeats! In this update, we’ve implemented much of the feedback you shared with us on Discord and at Lucca Comics.

You’ve been a big part of shaping these updates, are you excited?

[b]Nightmare Mode Tweaks[/b]: You no longer lose life in Nightmares, and you actually gain a life if you take down the Nightmare!

[b]Localization[/b]: Heartbeats is now available in [b]Chinese [/b]and [b]Portuguese[/b]! Special thanks to prindaisynha !

[h3]Gameplay and Feature Updates![/h3]
- Updated tutorial for improved clarity
- Fixed a bug with BPM in credits
- Fixed an issue with stage selection
- Resolved a bug with Killchain progression
- Added gamepad analog navigation for character selection and leaderboard
- Improved Leaderboard selection for global and friends categories
- In the boss fight’s 4th phase, veins now spawn correctly as Traumas
- Adjusted spawn size for pointing hands in the 2nd phase
- New sounds added for boss dive and emerge animations
- Keyboard number pad Enter now works like the standard Enter
- After a game, you can now return to the main screen from the Leaderboard

[h3]Coming Next![/h3]
- New feedback for lives gained and extra points
- Enhanced visual cues on enemy behavior
- Improvements for heartbeat perception on enemies and previews

Plus, a bit of spoiler, but we’re working on new characters that will be available in December!

notes.content:

[*] [b]New![/b] Tutorial! It's now clearer what's going on.

So buckle up, because we’re shifting into high gear as we race toward the official release!

notes.title: Heartbeats Demo Update!
notes.content:
Welcome back to the weekly update! We’re always here with fresh news to keep you in the loop!

Last week, we launched our "Open Localization Program" to help you introduce new languages based on your needs. It was a huge success! [b]Thanks to Nolan[/b], Heartbeats now has full French support! If you wanna get involved in the program, make sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8VTYq8NYKf]Discord[/url] first!

[h2]Updates[/h2]

We've done some *bip* *bup* *clank* ("fix" sounds boring) with a full changelog below.

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New![/b] Full French Localization Support ( Nolan ❤️ )
[*] [b]New![/b] Added an Epilepsy Warning at startup, just to keep everyone safe.
[*] [b]New![/b] Bullets now vanish more smoothly during stage transitions and other game moments.
[*] [b]New![/b] The Tutorial reset now matches the in-game reset better, so it feels more consistent.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI Prompts are now a bit bigger. You don’t have to squint to see them!
[*] Fixed a bug with Harmony shooting. Bullets were sneaking past enemies without hitting them when close. We’ve sorted that out! 
[*] Moved the reset button on keyboard from "space" to "esc" so now it's a bit more convenient!
[*] Turned up the ability recharge volume just a tad so you can hear it better, but it won’t be too noisy.
[*] Tidied up the letters on the Ranking screen for a cleaner look.
[*] Fixed the Italian and English Localization.
[/list]

See you next week, stay tuned!

[b]New![/b] The Tutorial reset now matches the in-game reset better, so it feels more consistent.

notes.title: Heartbeats Demo Update!
notes.content:
This week has been [i]intense[/i]! Last week, we released the demo, and you provided us with tons of helpful feedback that will significantly aid in the development of the game. By the way, if you haven't done so yet, hop on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8VTYq8NYKf]Discord[/url] and let us know your thoughts about the demo!

We've fixed some bugs and made adjustments to create a smoother, more accessible experience while keeping your heart engaged.

For additional details, please check out the full changelog below.

[h2]Updates[/h2]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the game from continuing after pressing "retry" following the tutorial.
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now exit the tutorial at any time, so if you accidentally enter it, you're no longer stuck watching the whole sequence.
[*] The timing of the tutorial sequence has been shortened, making it more responsive and less frustrating.
[/list]
[h3]Accessibility[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a slider to adjust the game's master volume.
[/list]

[h1]But that's not all![/h1]
Alongside more updates coming in the next few weeks, we've also added a [b]new achievement in the demo[/b]. The challenge is set: will you conquer it, or will your anxieties overwhelm you?
